tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Get the full transcript of a YouTube or TikTok video, an Instagram Reel or a podcast episode. Uses captions or the publisher's transcript when available (1 credit), otherwise transcribes the audio (1 credit per started minute). Returns plain text by default, optionally with [mm:ss] timestamps, or as

tools.name: get_video_metadata
tools.description: Get title, channel or show, duration, views, likes, upload date, thumbnail and available caption languages of a video, Reel or podcast episode. Costs 1 credit on success.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the videos (id, title, duration, URL) of a YouTube playlist or channel, newest first for channels, or the episodes of a podcast, newest first. Use it before get_transcript to work on a whole playlist, a channel's recent uploads or a podcast's episodes. Costs 1 credit on success.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_videos · Public sink: get_video_metadata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_videos · Public sink: get_video_metadata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the full transcript (captions) of a YouTube video. Returns plain text by default, optionally with [mm:ss] timestamps, or as SRT/VTT subtitles. Costs 1 credit on success." → after: "Get the full transcript of a YouTube or TikTok video, an Instagram Reel or a podcast episode. Uses captions or the publisher's transcript when available (1 credit), otherwise transcribes the audio (1 credit per started minute). findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
